title: Phrase and Proximity Queries: Visual Guide
outline: Title: Phrase and Proximity Queries: Visual Guide

1. Terms Or Places | a toggle between document-level and positional postings for the document 'neural vector database and vector database', with five questions marked CAN ANSWER or CANNOT TELL under each | document postings record presence and discard order, so phrases, proximity and highlight locations are unanswerable until positions are stored

2. The Price Of Positions | sliders over documents, tokens per document and distinct terms per document, showing P term-document pairs against T token occurrences, the GB of raw 32-bit positions, and a gap-encoding toggle on [7,31,35] | positions are O(T) over occurrences while document postings are O(P) over pairs and T is never less than P, so the real dial is which fields carry positions at all

3. Marching The Positions | a steppable two-cursor merge of vector [2,10,20] against database [3,12,21] in doc 7, with a slop slider from 0 to 3 | phrase verification is the postings intersection one level down, matching where p_d equals p_v plus 1, and slop changes the question rather than tuning it

4. Taking A Skip | the intersection of A=[2,4,8,16,32,64,128] with a choosable B, under three policies: no skips, skips with the destination rule obeyed, and skips with it ignored | a skip may be taken only when its destination is at or below the opposing cursor, and ignoring that rule silently drops real matches rather than merely running slow

5. Sizing The Skips | a dial over the number of skips in a million-entry list showing L/k + k against every choice, plus a workload switch from a lopsided intersection to two identical dense lists | about sqrt(L) skips minimises traversal on unequal lists, while skips cannot help a dense intersection whose output is already Omega(1,000,000)
